items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: If you've seen Corrine, please tell her to come home.

ctx.x: did he live? Oh Eddie Marsh. Eddie Marsh, he's still alive. Yeah. I think Eddie lives, I don't know, somewhere about. Oh yeah, St. Phillip. Yeah, up there. I just wondered if it was the same guy. Yeah, that's him. That looks like about the end of this reel. This is real. See, this is real too, Albert Giles. February the 24th, 1961. What kind of

jobs would a band like Rene play? Well he played advertisements, Sunday dances for clubs at home, and then he played clubs. Halls like the Corporators, Economy Hall, the Poitier Hall, the Jean-Amé Hall, the Fethian Tempher, all those old dance halls at that time. They had clubs mostly give dances, and you found men sponsored dances of their own and they charge admission. But they all had advertisements. The dances mostly was on Sunday night and Monday nights for colored people. And they would advertise and you…
He was really great blues man. Who did Chris have in his band, if you'd say so?
